unit_system: natural-HEP: GeV for energies and scales; R is dimensionless
metric_signature: not-applicable (no amplitude is computed in this profile)
coupling_normalization: expansion parameter a = alpha_s / pi, alpha_s = g_s^2 / (4 pi)
renormalization_scheme: MS-bar with n_f active massless flavours (PDG eqs. 9.3, 9.9)
scales: renormalization scale mu; coefficients c_n given at mu = Q; scale-dependent d_n(L), L = ln(mu^2 / Q^2); central mu = Q, envelope over mu in [Q/2, 2Q]
energy_variable: Q = sqrt(s), the e+e- centre-of-mass energy
mass_approximation: all n_f active quarks massless; heavier quarks decoupled; no threshold crossed between m_Z and the lowest scale used
qcdr:observable: R = sigma(e+e- -> hadrons) / sigma(e+e- -> mu+mu-), photon exchange only, R_EW = N_c sum e_q^2 [qcdr:C01]
qcdr:alpha_s_input: alpha_s(m_Z) = 0.1180 +- 0.0009 [qcdr:C04], run with the three-loop beta function at fixed n_f = 5
